sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def cart(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('O','B'):
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            d[n['color']]=(min(rows),min(cols),max(rows),max(cols))
    return d
# move player to safe top-left
for m in ['LEFT']*5:
    action([m], intent='explore')
    if last_action_result.get('no_impact') or last_action_result.get('done'): break
print('player now', [n['boundary'][0] for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N'], cart(current_frame))
# oscillate to advance time, log cart
path=['RIGHT','LEFT']*8
for m in path:
    action([m], intent='explore')
    r=last_action_result
    if r.get('no_impact') or r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed'): 
        print('stop',r.get('no_impact'),r.get('level_completed')); break
    print(m, cart(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def cart(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('O','B'):
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            d[n['color']]=(min(rows),min(cols),max(rows),max(cols))
    return d
# move player to safe top-left

    if last_action_result.get('no_impact') or last_action_result.get('done'): break

path=['RIGHT','LEFT']*8
for m in path:
